title: Manager Pause / Resume of Individual Sub-Account Participation
steps: 1. Manager or Admin toggles sub-account #7 to 'Paused'.2. Master executes new trade.
expected_result: Sub-account #7 excluded from new order allocation; existing positions maintained; remaining sub-accounts receive trades.
actual_result: Sub-account state toggling between active and ended safely halts order fan-out without closing open positions.
